detail: Second watchdog (~1hr after primary, ~45min after watchdog1) re-checked for Daily Job Report email from onservicetitan.com dated today (2026-10-06). Still zero results via outlook_email_search (sender=onservicetitan.com, afterDateTime=2026-10-06T00:00:00). Confirmed connector works: broad sender-only search returns 110 total ServiceTitan emails, newest batch still dated 2026-10-05 ~12:01-12:08 UTC (includes Daily Job Report). Nothing new has arrived today as of this check (2026-10-06T13:1X UTC). Primary (run_context=scheduled) and watchdog1 (run_context=watchdog) independently found the same thing earlier today. Stopping per Step 1 instructions without running daily_sync.js -- no email means no data to sync. Likely a delayed/failed ServiceTitan scheduled export, or a mail delivery issue upstream of this account -- now 3 independent runs today confirming the same gap.
